# Cityline Consultancy

> Strategic facilitation and advisory firm connecting Indian talent, specialists, and entrepreneurs with United Arab Emirates residency visas, corporate company formation, and cross-border manpower recruitment solutions.

Cityline Consultancy operates across the India–UAE corridor, providing structured procedural coordination, document preparation, and advisory services for individuals and corporations seeking legal residency, employment, and business operations in Dubai and across the UAE.

## Core Services

### 1. 2-Year Freelance Visa Dubai Assistance
- **Scope**: Comprehensive advisory and facilitation for individuals seeking independent, legal 2-year UAE residency.
- **Key Inclusions**:
  - 2-Year renewable UAE residency visa facilitation.
  - Freelance work permit coordination in compliance with UAE labor and immigration regulations.
  - Emirates ID biometrics and medical fitness test typing advisory.
  - Assistance with personal UAE bank account opening guidance.
  - Family sponsorship eligibility consultation.
- **Target Audience**: Skilled professionals, software engineers, digital creators, consultants, technical specialists, and independent tradespeople.
- **Process**: Initial profile assessment → Document collection and verification → Entry permit issuance → In-country medical & biometric formalities → Residency visa stamping.
- **Link**: [2-Year Freelance Visa Details](https://citylineconsultancy.com/visa-services/freelance-visa/)

### 2. UAE Visit Visas (30-Day & 60-Day)
- **Scope**: Fast, structured application facilitation for short-term entry permits to the UAE.
- **30-Day Visit Visa**: Single-entry stay ideal for tourism, short business meetings, or exploring career opportunities.
- **60-Day Visit Visa**: Extended-stay entry permit offering sufficient time for in-person job interviews, commercial networking, and exploratory market research.
- **Status Change Guidance**: Consultation on in-country status adjustment if employment or freelance residency is secured before visa expiration.
- **Links**:
  - [30-Day Visit Visa](https://citylineconsultancy.com/visa-services/visit-visa-30-days/)
  - [60-Day Visit Visa](https://citylineconsultancy.com/visa-services/visit-visa-60-days/)

### 3. UAE Business Setup & Company Formation Advisory
- **Scope**: Turnkey corporate setup advisory for founders, SMEs, and international enterprises entering the UAE market.
- **Jurisdictions**:
  - **Mainland (DED)**: 100% foreign ownership on eligible commercial activities with freedom to trade across the UAE local market and government tenders.
  - **Free Zones (e.g. IFZA, Meydan, DAFZA, JAFZA, DMCC)**: 100% foreign ownership, 0% personal income tax, 100% capital repatriation, and streamlined regulatory reporting.
  - **Offshore Entities**: Asset protection, international contracting, and holding structure solutions.
- **Corporate Services**:
  - Trade license selection and activity structuring.
  - Commercial registration, trade name reservation, and initial approvals.
  - Investor and partner visa processing.
  - Corporate bank account introduction and documentation guidance.
  - Corporate PRO services, tenancy contract (Ejari) coordination, and establishment cards.
- **Link**: [UAE Business Setup](https://citylineconsultancy.com/business-setup/)

### 4. Cross-Border Manpower Recruitment (India to UAE)
- **Scope**: End-to-end recruitment, trade validation, and compliant deployment connecting vetted Indian workforce with licensed UAE employers.
- **Operational Sectors**:
  - Hotel & Hospitality Staff (Front office, housekeeping, culinary, service)
  - Cleaning & Facility Care (Commercial cleaners, janitorial teams, facility maintenance)
  - Construction Trades (Civil block masons, steel fixers, shuttering carpenters)
  - Transport & Logistics (Bike delivery riders, taxi drivers, heavy truck drivers)
- **Employer Solutions**: High-volume manpower mobilization, candidate pre-screening, practical trade testing, medical fitness checks, and group visa deployment logistics.
- **Links**:
  - [Manpower Recruitment Solutions](https://citylineconsultancy.com/recruitment/)
  - [Employer Manpower Enquiry](https://citylineconsultancy.com/employer-enquiry/)

### 5. Jobs & Candidate Opportunities
- **Scope**: Active job listings in Dubai and the UAE for candidates seeking legitimate overseas employment.
- **Process**: Transparent role descriptions, salary disclosure, clear qualification requirements, and direct application submission without unauthorized placement fees.
- **Link**: [Explore UAE Jobs](https://citylineconsultancy.com/jobs/)

## Key Company Facts & Frequently Asked Questions

- **Official Website**: https://citylineconsultancy.com
- **Locations Served**: United Arab Emirates (Dubai operational center) and India (sourcing and candidate coordination hubs).
- **Does Cityline Consultancy guarantee visa issuance?**:
  No consultancy can legally guarantee visa approvals. Final approval and issuance of all entry permits, visas, and residency stamps remain subject to sovereign UAE immigration authorities (GDRFA / ICP / MOHRE). Cityline Consultancy ensures procedural compliance, correct document attestation, and error-free regulatory submission.
- **Can a freelancer sponsor family members on a 2-year Freelance Visa?**:
  Yes, individuals holding a valid 2-year UAE residency under freelance status can sponsor their spouse and children, provided they satisfy the minimum salary and accommodation requirements established by UAE immigration laws.
- **How do employers submit bulk manpower requests?**:
  Licensed UAE companies can submit headcount, trade requirements, and deployment deadlines through the [Employer Enquiry Portal](https://citylineconsultancy.com/employer-enquiry/) or consult directly with the corporate manpower desk.
